recommendationIntro: Recommended values describe regular Auto Advisor use; they are guidance and do not change saved settings.

items.label: Open settings
items.description: On the Automation page, select the settings button on the Auto Advisor card.

items.label: Source castle
items.description: Choose the Great Empire castle that supplies troops and tools for the Advisor run.
items.recommendation: Use your usual event castle with enough troops and tools.

items.label: Advisor attack preset
items.description: Select a saved Attack Preset whose troops, tools and formation are copied for every requested attack.
items.recommendation: Create a regular preset for the active Nomad or Samurai event first, then select it.

items.label: Horse travel boost
items.description: Choose the feather, coin or ruby travel option for the run.

items.label: Complete preset copies
items.description: Available resources and complete preset copies can reduce the run below the maximum attack count.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Advisor source, preset and travel settings
image.caption: Choose a Great Empire source castle and a saved event preset before setting travel.

items.label: Nomad difficulty
items.description: Choose an unlocked Nomad difficulty to select when that event starts.
items.recommendation: Use the highest unlocked difficulty your usual setup handles reliably.

items.label: Samurai difficulty
items.description: Choose an unlocked Samurai difficulty to select when that event starts.
items.recommendation: Use the highest unlocked difficulty your usual setup handles reliably.

items.label: Active event difficulty
items.description: Match the current difficulty of an already active event or this automation waits rather than changing it.

image.alt: Illustrative Nomad and Samurai Advisor difficulty choices
image.caption: Save both event difficulties and match the one already running.

steps.title: Set the run size and event time

items.label: Maximum attacks
items.description: Set an upper bound on attacks in this single Advisor run; resources and remaining event time may lower the actual count.
items.recommendation: 9,999 to let available resources and event time determine the run size.

items.label: Stop before event end
items.description: Leave this many minutes unused in the pre-launch event-time calculation.
items.recommendation: 30 minutes; this is not an ongoing cancellation timer.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Advisor attack-count and event-time settings
image.caption: The requested count is limited before launch by available resources and event time.

items.label: All-in coins per attack
items.description: Estimate the full coin cost per attack for the pre-launch affordability calculation without changing game prices.
items.recommendation: 500 only if it covers your actual full cost; otherwise use a higher measured total.

items.label: Keep coins
items.description: Exclude this many coins from the run budget.
items.recommendation: Keep your usual recruitment and building budget.

items.label: Rubies per attack
items.description: Estimate ruby travel cost per attack, with a positive value required when ruby travel is selected.
items.recommendation: 0 with Travel Feather; use the actual positive cost for ruby travel.

items.label: Keep rubies
items.description: Exclude this many rubies from the run budget.
items.recommendation: Keep the balance needed for other activities.

items.label: Keep feathers
items.description: Exclude this many travel feathers from the run budget.
items.recommendation: 0 unless you reserve feathers for other features.

items.label: Keep 60m
items.description: Keep this many 60m time-skip items untouched as a reserve.

items.label: Keep 5h
items.description: Keep this many 5h time-skip items untouched as a reserve.
items.recommendation: Reserve the stock you need for building or other activities.

items.label: Keep 24h
items.description: Keep this many 24h time-skip items untouched as a reserve.
items.recommendation: Reserve the stock you need for building or other activities.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Advisor coin, ruby, feather and time-skip reserves
image.caption: Cost fields are planning estimates; keep values count resources or time-skip items left unused.

steps.title: Save, enable and activate Advisor access

items.label: Save settings
items.description: Save the source, preset, difficulties, run size and resource budgets before closing this dialog.

items.label: Auto Advisor switch
items.description: Enable Auto Advisor on its Automation card after reviewing the settings; an already unlocked Advisor may launch a run immediately.
items.recommendation: On after reviewing and saving your intended settings.

items.label: Activate Advisor
items.description: If Advisor is locked, choose Activate Advisor to open confirmation for the current event.

items.label: Confirm paid activation
items.description: Acknowledge that activating Advisor may consume an event or universal token unless the game reports this event as free.

items.label: Activate and spend token
items.description: Submit the confirmed activation using an eligible event token or universal Advisor token; a free event shows Activate advisor instead.

items.label: Cancel activation
items.description: Close the confirmation without submitting an activation or spending a token.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Advisor save and token activation controls
image.caption: Saving or enabling does not spend a token; the separate confirmed activation may do so.

items.label: Refresh overview
items.description: Request updated Advisor run progress, wins, defeats and losses.

items.label: Live Advisor run
items.description: Read the current attack count, requested count, wins, defeats, lost units and lost tools in the overview.

items.label: Completed or cancelled run
items.description: A completed or cancelled run for the same event is not automatically started again.

image.alt: Illustrative Auto Advisor progress and loss overview
image.caption: The overview shows run progress and losses without starting another run.
